Class DashboardController

java.lang.Object
library.controllers.common.CommonDashboardController
library.controllers.librarian.DashboardController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable, RequiresLoggedIn
public final class DashboardController extends CommonDashboardController
Controller to manage the various sections of the dashboard. This class provides methods to load specific dashboard components. It extends CommonDashboardController which includes shared functionality for all dashboard controllers.
